summary: Verified end-to-end AI PDF extraction flow on Facturas Recibidas with real Gemini call. Backend /api/consumos-ia/resumen works, UI shows per-read consumo-ia and accumulated consumo-ia-resumen; num_lecturas incremented 1->2 after new extraction; row saved with origen 'IA'.

design_issues.screen: Facturas Recibidas - consumo IA card & per-read
issues: Coste EUR is formatted via eur() with 2 decimals so tiny amounts (e.g. 0,00212 €) render as '0,00 €' both in per-read (consumo-ia) and accumulated card (consumo-ia-resumen). Recommend showing 4-5 decimals or milli-euro notation for AI costs so users see a non-zero value (backend returns coste_eur=0.00212 correctly).
Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — accessibility only, non-blocking.

action_items: Improve euro formatting for AI cost fields (per-read + summary) so 0.00212 € doesn't display as 0,00 €. Use a dedicated formatter with 4-5 decimals or show '<0,01 €' fallback.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to ImportPdfDialog and recibida-dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py extraer_pdf/consumos-ia paths look clean; coste_eur rounded to 5 decimals and stored in consumos_ia — good.
FacturasRecibidas.jsx: getConsumoIA errors are silently swallowed (.catch(()=>{})) — acceptable but hides potential 5xx; consider logging in dev.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /tmp/factura_test.pdf; one new consumos_ia record + one new factura recibida (Suministros Iberia SL, FRA-2026-045, total 108,90 €, origen ai_pdf).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI extraction flow validated. Per-read consumo returned 1280 tokens (~0.0019 EUR) for the same PDF; accumulated card went from Lecturas 1/Tokens 1443 to Lecturas 2/Tokens 2723. Only remaining polish is EUR formatting for sub-cent AI costs.
